supplements.title: Protective Role of Apigenin-PEGylated Chitosan Nanoparticles Against Pesticide Deltamethrin-Induced Liver Injury via Antioxidant Activation, NF-κB Inhibition, and Bcl-2/Bax/Caspase-3 Signaling Modulation.
supplements.summary: Apigenin-loaded nanoparticles effectively protect rat livers from pesticide damage by boosting antioxidants and reducing inflammation.

supplements.title: Exploring the potential targets and mechanisms of artemisinin in the treatment of diabetic kidney disease using network pharmacology and molecular docking.
supplements.summary: Artemisinin may treat diabetic kidney disease by restoring the FLT1 protein, which protects kidney cells from high-glucose damage.

supplements.title: A bioactive pigment from violet-hued bacteria: a dual approach against prostate cancer and bacterial infections.
supplements.summary: A purple pigment from soil bacteria kills prostate cancer cells and fights bacterial infections effectively.

supplements.title: Individual Short-Chain Fatty Acids Differentially Reprogram Transcriptional States in Colorectal Cancer Cells.
supplements.summary: Different short-chain fatty acids from gut bacteria alter gene expression patterns differently in colorectal cancer cells.

supplements.title: Biomimetic Nanoparticles Based on Tumor Cell Membrane Co-loaded with Vitamin E and Doxorubicin for Targeted Synergistic Treatment of Bladder Cancer.
supplements.summary: Nanoparticles coated with cancer cell membranes and loaded with vitamin E and chemotherapy drug effectively treat bladder cancer with reduced toxicity.

supplements.title: Integrated Network Pharmacology and Machine Learning to Reveal the Mechanisms of Schisandrin A Against Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
supplements.summary: Schisandrin A inhibits triple-negative breast cancer cell growth by targeting GSK3B and IDO1 proteins, blocking cell cycle progression and triggering cell death.

supplements.title: Histopathological and Epigenetic Insights Into Radioprotective Effects of Homeopathic Cadmium Sulfuratum in Swiss Albino Mice.
supplements.summary: Homeopathic Cadmium Sulfuratum reduced radiation damage to intestines in mice by altering miRNA expression patterns.

supplements.title: Computational Analysis of Differentially Expressed Genes in Arsenic-Induced Carcinogenesis and Their Effect on Human Repair Mechanisms.
supplements.summary: Arsenic exposure damages DNA repair genes, but curcumin compounds may reverse mutations and reduce cancer risk through molecular intervention.

supplements.title: Clinacanthus nutans in modern therapeutics: pharmacological insights and emerging clinical applications.
supplements.summary: Clinacanthus nutans, a Southeast Asian plant, shows promise against cancer through anti-inflammatory and antioxidant mechanisms, requiring further clinical testing.

supplements.title: Acute cancer-related fatigue response following exercise during an outpatient cancer rehabilitation program.
supplements.summary: Exercise during cancer rehabilitation immediately reduces fatigue in cancer survivors, with effects varying based on workout intensity.

supplements.title: Polytrichastrum alpinum methanol extract induces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in mammary tumor cells of companion dogs.
supplements.summary: A plant extract stops growth and kills canine mammary tumor cells, offering a potentially safer alternative to standard chemotherapy.

supplements.title: Sclerofish A and B: Two Pairs of Enantiomeric Diterpenoids Featuring a 4/7/6-Fused Tricyclic Scaffold from the Soft Coral Sclerophytum humesi.
supplements.summary: Two new compounds from soft coral show promise against liver cancer cells, with one pair exhibiting strong selective toxicity.

supplements.title: Changes in Cancer Stem Cell Signalling Pathways With Plant Metabolites to Discover Chemotherapy.
supplements.summary: Plant metabolites like curcumin and resveratrol can alter cancer stem cell signaling pathways, potentially triggering differentiation and death as a new chemotherapy approach.

supplements.title: Exercise hormone irisin alleviates rheumatoid arthritis by removing dysfunctional mitochondria.
supplements.summary: Exercise hormone irisin treats rheumatoid arthritis by activating the removal of damaged mitochondria in immune cells.

supplements.title: Remote mobilization of gut Tregs exosomes serves as nanoshuttles for targeted cardioprotection against ischemia/reperfusion injury by ginseng polysaccharides.
supplements.summary: Ginseng polysaccharides protect hearts from injury by activating gut immune cells to release healing exosomes that travel through the bloodstream.

off_label.title: Combinatorial drug repurposing of Valproic acid and Zebularine regulates Krüppel-like factor 4 and β-catenin expression in colon cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Combining two repurposed drugs effectively inhibits colon cancer cell growth by altering key cancer-related gene expression.

off_label.title: Novel Long-Acting Ghrelin Analogue PEP-064 Restores Energy Balance in C26 and Lewis Lung Carcinoma-Induced cachexia in Mice.
off_label.summary: A new long-acting ghrelin drug called PEP-064 successfully restores weight and energy balance in mice with cancer cachexia.

off_label.title: Alogliptin-metformin synergy ameliorates diabetes-associated bone loss via modulation of DPP-4 activity and OPG/RANKL signaling.
off_label.summary: Combined alogliptin-metformin treatment protects bones in diabetic rats by reducing inflammation and restoring bone-regulating protein balance.

off_label.title: Fuzuloparib enhances radiosensitivity of gain-of-function mutant p53 R273H NSCLC by promoting SLC7A11/GSH/GPX4 axis mediated ferroptosis.
off_label.summary: Fuzuloparib enhances radiation therapy effectiveness in mutant p53 lung cancer by triggering cell death through ferroptosis.

off_label.title: Effect of Olanzapine on Opioid Craving and Misuse Among Patients Receiving Opioids for Cancer-related Pain: A Pilot Double-Blind, Randomized Control Trial
off_label.summary: Olanzapine may reduce opioid craving and misuse in cancer patients taking long-term pain medications.

off_label.title: Double Blind, Randomised, Placebo-controlled Study of Propranolol in Infantile Capillary Hemangiomas
off_label.summary: Propranolol, a common blood pressure medication, effectively slows growth of facial hemangiomas in infants under four months old.

off_label.title: Standardized workflow enables reproducibility of drug synergism detection: Results from a multi-center in vitro ring test on complex drug combinations in pancreatic cancer models.
off_label.summary: Standardized procedures across labs confirmed that combining valproic acid and simvastatin enhances pancreatic cancer cell death, improving reproducibility in drug synergy studies.

off_label.title: Non-enzymatic RNA Glycation is a Metabolic Sensor of Cellular Stress
off_label.summary: RNA glycation from metabolic stress impairs protein production and insulin secretion in pancreatic cells, but metformin reverses this effect.

off_label.title: Unveiling Remyelinating Properties of Roflumilast in CPZ-Induced Neuronal Demyelination in Mice.
off_label.summary: Roflumilast, a PDE-4 inhibitor, promotes remyelination and reduces inflammation in a mouse multiple sclerosis model.

off_label.title: Bevacizumab for Radiation-Induced (Radiculo)plexopathy.
off_label.summary: Bevacizumab shows promise as the first potential treatment for nerve damage that develops years after cancer radiation therapy.

off_label.title: Multi-omics reveals a novel Cxcr4+ subpopulation of alveolar macrophages and therapeutic effect of AMD3100 in mice with advanced silicosis.
off_label.summary: AMD3100 treatment reduces lung fibrosis in silicosis by targeting a specific immune cell population, offering a potential therapy for this occupational disease.

off_label.title: Potential Benefit of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2-Inhibitors in Cisplatin-Associated Nephrotoxicity Among Patients With Cancer Having Diabetes Mellitus.
off_label.summary: SGLT2 inhibitors may protect kidneys from cisplatin damage in cancer patients with diabetes by reducing drug uptake in kidney cells.

off_label.title: The GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Liraglutide Promotes Anticancer Activities in MCF7 Breast and PC-3 Prostate Cancer Cells by Modulating Glycolysis, Oxidative Stress and Adipokines.
off_label.summary: Liraglutide, a diabetes drug, kills breast and prostate cancer cells by increasing oxidative stress and triggering cell death pathways.

off_label.title: Real-world Clinical Outcomes of Ivermectin and Mebendazole in Cancer Patients: Results from a Prospective Observational Cohort.
off_label.summary: Antiparasitic drugs ivermectin and mebendazole show promise as accessible, low-toxicity cancer treatments in real-world patient use.

off_label.title: Looming Concerns With Gabapentin Oversight: Balancing Safety and Access.
off_label.summary: Gabapentin regulation as a controlled substance may improve safety but risks limiting access for vulnerable patients needing pain relief.

biomarkers.title: Do BKPyV genomic features underlie clinical divergence between kidney and hematopoietic transplant recipients?
biomarkers.summary: Host immune factors, not viral genetics, primarily determine whether BK polyomavirus causes kidney damage or bladder bleeding in transplant patients.

biomarkers.title: Clinical manifestations and ultrasonographic features of lobular endocervical glandular hyperplasia: a retrospective study of 135 patients.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified ultrasound imaging features that help detect early cervical cancer precursor lesions in 135 patients.

biomarkers.title: Cathepsin S regulates germinal center reactions and anti-tumor humoral responses.
biomarkers.summary: Cathepsin S enzyme activity balances immune responses, preventing lymphoma while boosting anti-tumor antibody production in lung and colorectal cancers.

biomarkers.title: Aquaporin-1 sustains lymphangiogenic responses in hyperosmotic inflammatory microenvironments.
biomarkers.summary: A water channel protein called AQP1 enables intestinal lymph vessels to adapt to high-salt, inflammatory environments and absorb dietary fats.

biomarkers.title: Human germline biallelic loss-of-function OSMR variants cause severe allergic disease.
biomarkers.summary: Mutations in the OSMR gene cause severe allergic skin disease by impairing immune cell signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Crotonylation impedes c-Myc oncogenic activity.
biomarkers.summary: A chemical modification called crotonylation reduces c-Myc cancer protein activity, and mutations blocking this modification increase cancer risk.

biomarkers.title: HLA micropolymorphisms confine neoantigen conformational adaptability and guide T cell receptor selectivity.
biomarkers.summary: Small HLA protein differences alter cancer neoantigen shape, preventing immune cells from recognizing the same mutation across different HLA types.

biomarkers.title: A targeted combination therapy achieves effective pancreatic cancer regression and prevents tumor resistance.
biomarkers.summary: Combining three targeted drugs—targeting KRAS, EGFR, and STAT3—completely shrinks pancreatic tumors and prevents treatment resistance.

biomarkers.title: [Key points and interpretation of Chinese expert's consensus on endocrine therapy of breast cancer (2026 edition)].
biomarkers.summary: Chinese experts updated 2026 guidelines for breast cancer hormone therapy, expanding CDK4/6 inhibitor use and improving treatment precision across disease stages.

biomarkers.title: Racial disparities in the survival outcomes of craniopharyngioma: a 17-year population-based analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Black and Hispanic craniopharyngioma patients experience worse survival rates than white patients, highlighting significant racial disparities in outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Symptomatic manifestation of a cauda equina arteriovenous fistula after resection of a coexisting spinal schwannoma: illustrative case.
biomarkers.summary: A rare spinal nerve bundle fistula became symptomatic only after surgical removal of a coexisting benign tumor.

biomarkers.title: Bilateral dumbbell-shaped ganglioneuroma of the C2 roots in a patient with Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease: illustrative case.
biomarkers.summary: Doctors report the first known case of rare benign nerve tumors occurring with Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease.

biomarkers.title: Evolving approaches to craniopharyngioma diagnosis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers are developing noninvasive diagnostic methods, including imaging and blood tests, to replace invasive surgical biopsies for craniopharyngioma.

biomarkers.title: Standard Versus Reduced Sotorasib Dosing in KRAS G12C-Mutated Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis-Have We Answered the Dosing Question?
biomarkers.summary: Sotorasib's standard lung cancer dose may be unnecessarily high; lower doses show similar benefits with fewer side effects.

biomarkers.title: Tumor-Agnostic Therapies: Translating Scientific Breakthroughs Into Global Implementation.
biomarkers.summary: Tumor-agnostic drugs show promise but face major global implementation barriers, requiring coordinated strategies to ensure equitable access across all regions.

trials.summary: Nivolumab after surgery improved survival outcomes in patients with resectable non-small cell lung cancer compared to observation alone.

trials.title: Rare EGFRm NSCLC: More First-Line Options Emerge.
trials.summary: Two new drug combinations show promise as first-line treatments for rare types of lung cancer with specific EGFR mutations.

trials.summary: Community-delivered HPV self-sampling increased cervical cancer screening uptake in rural Thailand compared to facility-based approaches.

trials.title: Antibody-Drug Conjugates for Locally Advanced and Metastatic Urothelial Carcinoma: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
trials.summary: New antibody-drug conjugate treatments show promise for advanced bladder cancer, potentially improving patient outcomes compared to traditional therapies.
